14-Day Best of Turkey & Greece: Complete Highlights
summary:
The 14-Day Best of Turkey & Greece Highlights Tour gives each stage of the journey room to breathe, moving from Istanbul and central Anatolia to Turkey’s Aegean heritage before continuing into Greece. Explore Istanbul and Cappadocia, then travel west for Ephesus and Pamukkale. Athens marks the transition into the Greek portion, followed by Mykonos and Santorini, where the schedule allows dedicated island time alongside the guided cultural visits earlier in the trip.
Two weeks create a more balanced pace across both countries. Selected 4-star hotels, daily breakfast, English-speaking local guides, entrance fees during guided visits, domestic flights, Greek ferries, airport transfers and scheduled sightseeing are included.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Morning Bosphorus cruise and then Flight to Cappadocia
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable Bosphorus cruise, sailing between Europe and Asia along one of the world’s most scenic waterways. After the tour, transfer to the airport at 15:00 for your flight to Nevsehir at 18:45. Upon arrival at 20:10, and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text:
Optional: Early morning hot air balloon ride over Cappadocia.
After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of North Cappadocia. Visit Uchisar Castle for panoramic views, followed by Rose Valley, Pasabag, and the Zelve Open Air Museum, famous for fairy chimneys and cave dwellings. After lunch, continue to Devrent Valley and Three Beauties, then visit the charming towns of Urgup and Avanos, known for traditional pottery. After the tour, return to the hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: South Cappadocia Tour & Flight to Izmir
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a full-day tour of South Cappadocia. Visit Ortahisar Castle, the former Greek village of Mustafapaşa, and the Roman ruins of Sobesos Ancient City. Continue to Soğanlı Valley for a scenic walk through its cave churches, followed by lunch. After lunch, explore Kaymakli Underground City, one of Cappadocia’s most famous underground settlements. After the tour, transfer to Kayseri Airport for your flight to Izmir at 22:50. Upon arrival at 00:20, meet and transfer to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Tour of Ephesus
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a guided tour of Ephesus, one of the best-preserved ancient cities in the world. Enter through the Magnesia Gate and walk past remarkable landmarks including the Odeon, Library of Celsus, Temple of Hadrian, Fountain of Trajan, and the impressive Great Theatre, where Saint Paul once preached. Continue to the ruins of the Temple of Artemis, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. After lunch, visit the sacred House of the Virgin Mary. Overnight in Kusadasi

itinerary.title: Pamukkale & Hierapolis Day tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 07:30, depart for Pamukkale to explore its famous white travertine terraces, known as the “Cotton Castle,” and the ancient city of Hierapolis. Guests may also enjoy swimming at the famous Cleopatra Antique Pools (optional, extra entrance fee applies). After the tour, drive back to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Izmir to Santorini Via Athens by Flight
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel and free time until transfer to Izmir Airport for your evening flight via Athens to Santorini.
Upon arrival, meet and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Free day in Santorini
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a free day at leisure in Santorini to explore its whitewashed villages, dramatic cliffs, and scenic views.
Optional visit to Oia to enjoy the island’s famous sunset. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Santorini to Mykonos By Ferry
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel, then transfer to the port for your ferry to Mykonos.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and enjoy free time to explore the island.
Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Free day in Mykonos
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a free day at leisure in Mykonos to explore the island’s charming whitewashed streets, cafés, boutiques, and beautiful beaches. Relax by the sea or wander through the lively town center and waterfront area. In the evening, you may optionally experience the famous nightlife of Mykonos. Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Mykonos to Athens By Ferry
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel and check-out. Transfer to the port for your ferry to Athens.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel and enjoy free time at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Half Day Morning Athens City Tour
itinerary.text:
Enjoy a guided tour of Athens, including the iconic Acropolis of Athens, Parthenon, and Acropolis Museum.
Continue past the Parliament House, Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, Panathenaic Stadium, Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Arch of Hadrian. Return to the hotel. Free time at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Departure from Athens
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Athens Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 14-Day Best of Turkey and Greece Tour?
faqs.a: The 14-Day Best of Turkey and Greece Tour covers Istanbul, Cappadocia, Kusadasi, Pamukkale, Athens, and Santorini. You will explore Istanbul's historic landmarks, discover Cappadocia's fairy chimneys and underground cities, visit Ephesus and the thermal terraces of Pamukkale, and continue to Greece to experience Athens' ancient monuments and Santorini's world-famous sunsets. The tour runs for 13 nights and 14 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 14-Day Best of Turkey and Greece Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from 3,195 euros per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, domestic flights within Turkey, the international flight between Turkey and Greece, ferry tickets, guided tours, entrance fees, selected meals, and all airport, hotel, and port transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates, hotel category, and availability.

faqs.q: Are flights and ferry tickets included in this 14-day itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes domestic flights within Turkey, the international flight between Turkey and Greece, and ferry transportation as outlined in the itinerary. These travel arrangements help reduce travel time and allow you to enjoy more sightseeing throughout your journey.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 13 nights at carefully selected 4-star hotels and boutique accommodations with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, quality, and convenient locations near major attractions and transportation hubs. All airport, hotel, and port transfers are included throughout the tour.

faqs.q: Does the 14-day Turkey and Greece tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guides provide historical insights, cultural background, and local expertise while ensuring a smooth and enjoyable travel experience across both Turkey and Greece.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey and Greece?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who want to experience the most famous highlights of both countries. From Istanbul and Cappadocia to Ephesus, Pamukkale, Athens, and Santorini, it offers a comprehensive introduction to the region's history, culture, and natural beauty.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the 14-day tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historic districts, and areas with uneven surfaces, including Ephesus, Pamukkale, the Acropolis, and Cappadocia. Most travelers in average health can comfortably participate in the itinerary.

faqs.q: Is Santorini included in the tour?
faqs.a: Yes, Santorini is included in the itinerary. You will have time to enjoy the island's spectacular caldera views, whitewashed villages, volcanic scenery, and unforgettable sunsets, making it one of the highlights of the entire journey.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Best of Turkey and Greece Tour?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and peace of mind.

faqs.q: Is the 14-Day Best of Turkey and Greece Tour available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: The tour operates throughout the year, subject to seasonal ferry schedules, and can be customized according to your preferences. You can extend your stay in Istanbul, Athens, or Santorini, upgrade hotel categories, add optional excursions, or modify the itinerary. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
